newContinuationWork: Keeper-aware configuration aggregation from existing 96 cores (no simulation)

recovery.commitPlan: One local commit containing implementation and evidence, after remaining verification; never push.
recovery.reviewInterruption: An earlier process-inspection approval review could not complete due to a usage limit. It made no process changes; approval service subsequently permitted the preservation check.

finalEvidenceCommit: This receipt/report is in the final local evidence commit; its hash is recorded by verification/final-check.json and the final response.

rootVerdict.manpower: A: ordinary reductions/counts/eligibility/geometry correct in audited scope; proven second-goalkeeper command-admission bug fixed.
rootVerdict.foulLadder: B: proven stationary-airborne branch error and unannounced-discipline sequencing error fixed; remaining frequency/quality calibration is separate.
rootVerdict.possession: C: no engine clock/restart or observer counting inflation demonstrated in measured scope. High volume is actual canonical play.
rootVerdict.overall: D: A+B defects, with ordinary manpower and C structure verified. Dominant cause of the specific unavailable Human QA match or all scoring drift is NOT PROVEN.

changes.reason: Reject/cancel a keeper exchange that would leave another goalkeeper active.

Retain an existing stationary frontal containment through a subsequent takeoff.

delivery.buildSourceScope: Built from the verified audit working tree on the recorded base HEAD, before the single final code-and-evidence commit. Canonical source and preserved user/protected file hashes are checked before and after build and again after committing; unrelated user files are excluded from the task commit.

humanQA.instructions: Play 2-3 normal matches. Follow a suspension through the actual reduced unit, expiry and return; compare attack flow and Frikast/Bollforluster in live/final/archive Statistics. No continuous 2D, DevTools or imported QA saves required.

definitions.configuration: HOME field players v AWAY field players / HOME goalkeeper count v AWAY goalkeeper count. Actual total bodies are also explicit. A legal keeper removal may equalize field counts while leaving fewer total bodies and an empty goal.
definitions.duration: Intervals between already recorded actual court-population boundaries; official and simulation time separate.
definitions.events: Post-tick unit configuration. Field goals/attempts both use shot-release configuration. Counts and field conversion pool both teams within the HOME v AWAY configuration; they are not power-play efficiency estimates for just the attacking side.
definitions.possessions: Existing canonical possessionEconomy episode keys and aliases, never a new definition. Starts/mean attack duration stratify by starting configuration; losses by terminal configuration. A changing unit does not create a new possession.
definitions.sampling: Before40+40 and targeted after8+8 are distinct designs. Live option/width/coverage samples are from the two current production proof sessions.

limitations: Human QA Torslanda24-37Tumba save/seed was not supplied; no exact reproduction or Human approval is claimed.
Before80 and purposefully selected after16 serve different sampling purposes; after means do not estimate representative league changes.
Strict stationary frontal proof is a subset; initial moving probe bodies can brake before actual contact. Recorded contact speeds are authoritative.
The discipline model remains scoped, including no offensive-foul or post-sanction misconduct producer; full IHF rules are not certified.
Native/event-time role history is not universally stored. Foul role groupings label final core roles.
Second-attack/threat cycles are observational proxies from the existing reader, not extra canonical possessions.
Broad Bollforlust is NO DIRECT COMPARISON to official technical errors. Possession duration/volume/Frikast remain NO_REFERENCE.
Prior attribute benchmark1.60x remains a separate performance concern. Current ON/OFF timing is descriptive and includes observation/checkpoint overhead.
Retained Allsvenskan role/rating-branch fallback appearances are unchanged; no population/database repair was made.

resourceSafety.fullProductionProofs: Observed, plain, resumed separately for each league
